Upstream ZCHF issuance authority remains inherited from zchf-frankencoin.

controls.evidence: Immutable Savings (Leadrate + AbstractSavings) holds the vault's ZCHF principal and mints accrued interest via ZCHF.coverLoss() on refresh(). Qualified FPS equity holders (200-bps quorum verified on immutable Equity 0x1ba26788dfde592fec8bcb0eaff472a42be341b2) may call proposeChange(uint24,address[]) with a seven-day delay (604,800 seconds) before applyChange() updates currentRatePPM (currently 35,000 PPM / 3.50%). If currentRatePPM is set to 0, save() reverts with ModuleDisabled() while withdraw() remains callable. Savings cannot mint arbitrary svZCHF shares.
